topic: Handling incoming calls during an on-site customer estimate
hook_options: You are in a customer kitchen talking through an estimate. Phone buzzes in your pocket.
Answering your phone during an estimate makes you look bad either way.

Do you pull out your phone while pitching an estimate to a homeowner?

caption:
Answering your phone in front of a customer feels terrible.

Most homeowners judge you if you step away mid-pitch, but letting it ring out hands the caller straight to the next shop on the list.

Do you let incoming calls go to voicemail when you're estimating a job, or do you take them?
